entities.summary: Taharqa, a notable figure in the history of Sudan, associated with Kingdom of Kush (1070 BCE–590 BCE). Preceded by Napatan Period and 25th Dynasty. Their legacy influenced Nubian Pyramids and Meroitic Kingdom.
